headline: Skyward gets an engine
lede: The motor at Gullwing Isle used to beep only when something happened. Now it runs — a sustained engine bed that reads what the hull is doing, ducks when the rain shows up, and goes silent the moment you take the glider.

notes.text: ENGINE BED #3295 — the plane's hum rises with airspeed and climb load (louder AND brighter), the hover-board answers its fan, and a deep stall drops the engine to a near-cutout floor: the sound now teaches the physics.
Deep storm ducks the engine instead of duelling thunder, and the boarding/kill cues ride the pre-duck signal — flying through the cell can never fake an engine death.
Grind City learned rail grabs and coping stalls (#3293) while Pinball learned tilt-to-nudge on the phone (#3296).
Proof kept its teeth: 26 mutants all die, four of them new, and the score-spine hash is byte-identical with the bed on — replays never noticed.
